resources.string: No internet for street maps. Use offline packs.
Some map tiles unavailable. Tap to retry.
No offline map. Tap to set up maps.

Street maps load over the internet without a map account. Viewing sends the visible map area to the tile provider. Online tiles are cached for normal viewing; use a lab map pack for reliable offline coverage. No satellite imagery or terrain is downloaded automatically.
Automatic mode uses installed basemap or imagery packs. Outside their coverage, select Online street maps or import the correct regional pack.
